path: Path manipulation utilities, mirroring Node.js's `path` module.
path.basename: Returns the last portion of `path`, similar to the Unix `basename` command.
path.delimiter: The platform-specific path delimiter: `;` on Windows, `:` elsewhere.
path.dirname: Returns the directory name of `path`, similar to the Unix `dirname` command.
path.extname: Returns the extension of `path`, from the last `.` to the end of the string.
path.isAbsolute: Returns `true` if `path` is an absolute path.
path.join: Joins all given path segments using the platform-specific separator, then normalizes the result.
path.posix: The POSIX-specific implementation of the `path` methods.
path.relative: Returns the relative path from `from` to `to`.
path.resolve: Resolves a sequence of paths or path segments into an absolute path.
path.sep: The platform-specific path segment separator: `\` on Windows, `/` elsewhere.
path.toNamespacedPath: Converts `path` to a namespace-prefixed path on Windows; returns `path` unchanged on POSIX.
path.win32: The Windows-specific implementation of the `path` methods.
